guide.title: Admissions Guide for 2027 admission, international undergraduates (PDF) | KAIST
quotes: Thank you for your interest in KAIST (Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology).
291 Daehak-ro, Yuseong-gu, Daejeon 34141,
All international students receive full financial support, including tuition and living expenses.
Students enter KAIST without declaring a major and have the opportunity to explore various STEM fields
The official language of communication and instruction for international students at KAIST is English.
TOEFL iBT 83 (Taken before Jan 21, 2026) / 4.5 (Taken on or after Jan 21, 2026)
IELTS 6.5
(e.g., SAT, ACT, AP, IB, GCE A-Level, or other national high school leaving or university entrance
Interviews may be conducted if deemed necessary.

coa.title: Cost of Attendance | KAIST Office of Admissions
quotes: KAIST Scholarship covering entire tution fee for 4 years once admitted

sch.title: KAIST Scholarship | KAIST Office of Admissions
quotes: Full tuition fee: tuition exemption for 8 semesters
Living expenses: 350,000 KRW per month
Students must maintain GPA over 2.7 out of 4.3 at KAIST after their freshman year
Upon being selected for admission, you will automatically be entitled to the KAIST Scholarship.

program.name: Computer Science
program.summary: Computer Science at KAIST, Daejeon: enter with an undeclared major, choose it in year two; taught in English; the KAIST Scholarship covers tuition for admitted international students.

costs.academic_year: Cost of attendance as published (KAIST Office of Admissions)
costs.note: Tuition KRW 6,866,000 a year before the KAIST Scholarship, which covers the entire tuition for 4 years for admitted international students (plus a KRW 350,000 monthly stipend and NHI). Compulsory: NHI premiums KRW 916,680 a year. KAIST's own net figure is KRW 3,359,000 a year.

living.note: KAIST's cost of attendance: housing KRW 1,328,000 (shared Hee Mang Hall), food KRW 5,475,000 (school cafeteria) and books KRW 300,000 = KRW 7,103,000 a year. The KAIST Scholarship's KRW 350,000 monthly stipend (KRW 4,200,000 a year) isn't subtracted here.

admissions.threshold: Computer Science at KAIST: no published grade cut-off. You enter KAIST without a declared major and choose Computer Science in your second year. Applications are reviewed as a whole: transcripts, standardized test reports (e.g. SAT, ACT, AP, IB, GCE A-Level), English test, recommendation letters (highly recommended) and awards; interviews only if deemed necessary.

english.min_score: Recommended: TOEFL iBT 83 (taken before 21 Jan 2026) or 4.5 (from 21 Jan 2026), IELTS 6.5.
english.notes: Exempt: nationals of English-speaking countries listed by KAIST, or a high school taught in English (school letter needed).
